scene.speaker: oliver
scene.bubble: One day I'll play my songs in a huge stadium! What will YOU be, Maya?
scene.intro: One day I'll play my songs in a huge stadium, says Oliver, with a spoon as a microphone. Maya is more scientific: I'll be a scientist, I'll study the oceans and I won't work in an office. Oliver won't stop singing, that much is certain. Some dreams come true, some change, and both are fine. What will YOU be when you grow up? Say it out loud — the future starts here!

data.script: Oliver: In the future, I'll be a famous singer. I'll travel with my guitar to every country. … Maya: I'll study science at university. Then I'll work in a laboratory. … Oliver: Will you make a robot for me? … Maya: Maybe! It will carry your guitar and your suitcase. … Oliver: What about Ingrid? … Maya: She says she'll be a ship captain and explore the Arctic. … Oliver: And Diego will have his own TV programme, for sure. … Maya: And Kili? … Oliver: Kili won't change. He'll always be the best postman in the world!
